metadata.description: Deployment environment (uat, prod)
Azure region for all resources
Application name used in resource naming
Deploy Log Analytics + Application Insights. Off until the backend needs telemetry.
Deploy the Storage account (blob media). Off until the backend needs it.
Deploy Azure SQL server + database. Off until the backend needs it.
Deploy the backend host (App Service / Function App per hostingModel). Off until backend code exists.
Deploy Azure SignalR Service for real-time feed fan-out (social-api/03). Web-API-hosted hub (ServiceMode Default), independent of the Functions host. Off until the real-time story lands.
Azure SignalR SKU name. Free_F1 caps at 20 concurrent connections / 20k messages/day — fine for a smoke test; use Standard_S1 for real exercise load (burst legibility, SOC-071).
Deploy ACS + Email Service resources. Off until email is needed.
Deploy the Azure AI Foundry (Cognitive Services) account + E8 model deployments. Off until the engine needs a live endpoint.
Also deploy the Claude-on-Foundry (serverless MaaS) model tiers alongside the Azure OpenAI ones (for the E8 provider comparison). Requires deployAi and a Claude-eligible subscription.
Legal organization name for the Anthropic Marketplace attestation (modelProviderData), used only when deployClaude = true.

ROUTE ENGINE GENERATION TRAFFIC TO THE LIVE GOVERNED MODEL. Deliberately SEPARATE from deployAi: deployAi provisions the endpoint, this decides whether application code is pointed at it. OFF by default — flipping it makes the App Service resolve Generation:Provider = AzureOpenAI instead of Fake, i.e. real LLM egress. TIER-2 (NFR-005 / ADP-025): requires the signed sign-off in docs/features/engine-runtime/PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md §8 before it is set true in any environment.

TIER-2 HUMAN ASSERTION (NFR-005 §2), NOT a derived value: the signer attests that the generation endpoint is bounded to this tenant — a single-tenant Cognitive Services account, keyless (disableLocalAuth), no shared/public inference. Typed by the §8 signer in the environment parameter file, in the same reviewed commit as generationProviderLive. Deliberately NOT derived from deployAi: derived, it would make GenerationGovernance.Validate a restatement of deployAi instead of an independent gate. False by default, so a parameter file that omits it cannot accidentally assert a posture — and with a live provider a false assertion throws GenerationConfigurationException at startup (fail closed) rather than egressing.

TIER-2 HUMAN ASSERTION (NFR-005 §2 / ADP-025), NOT a derived value: the signer attests the contractual no-training terms covering this endpoint (Microsoft product terms for Azure OpenAI; the Anthropic Marketplace offer for Claude). Typed by the §8 signer in the environment parameter file alongside generationProviderLive; deliberately NOT derived from deployAi, for the same reason as generationTenantBounded. False by default (fail closed); a false assertion under a live provider throws at startup rather than egressing.
SQL Server admin login
SQL Server admin password
Override database name (defaults to sqldb-{appName}-{env})
Entra ID admin login email for SQL Server
Entra ID admin object ID for SQL Server
Which backend hosting model to deploy (only when deployBackend = true)
Frontend URL for CORS and auth redirect (e.g., https://uat-pulse.cobrasoftware.com)
Custom email domain (e.g., cobrasoftware.com). Leave empty to use Azure managed domain only.
Email sender address when deployCommunication=false (e.g., DoNotReply@xxx.azurecomm.net from shared ACS)
Override Static Web App name (defaults to stapp-{appName}-{env})
GitHub repository URL for Static Web App
Custom domain bound to the Static Web App (e.g. pulse-uat.cobrasoftware.com). Empty = none. Requires a registrar CNAME to the SWA default hostname (managed at the registrar, not here).
JWT signing key (32+ characters)

Bootstrap secret for the one-time UAT seed endpoint (Authentication:Bootstrap:Secret, story login/06). Empty -> the endpoint is disabled (fail closed). Threaded like jwtSecretKey, sourced from the BOOTSTRAP_SECRET GitHub secret in deploy-infrastructure.yml.

Phase-1 staff allowlist JSON array (Authentication:StaffIdentity:Accounts, story login/06). Empty -> no staff sign-in (fail closed). Threaded like jwtSecretKey, sourced from the STAFF_IDENTITY_ACCOUNTS_JSON GitHub secret; webapp.bicep expands it into the indexed app-setting keys the .NET options binder reads.
Azure Communication Services connection string for email

metadata.description: SKU name. Tier is derived from the prefix; constrained so the derivation can never drift.
Unit capacity for the SKU (Free is always 1; Standard/Premium scale out). Clamped to 1 on the Free tier so a misconfigured value cannot fail the deployment.
SignalR service mode. Default = the app server (Pulse.WebApi) hosts the hub and holds connections to the service. Serverless is only for the Azure Functions SignalR bindings.
Azure SignalR connection string for the Web-API-hosted real-time hub (social-api/03). Empty when SignalR is not deployed.

Bootstrap secret for the one-time UAT seed endpoint (Authentication:Bootstrap:Secret, story login/05-06). Empty by default -> the endpoint is disabled entirely (fail closed). Threaded exactly like jwtSecretKey; never committed to appsettings.

Phase-1 staff allowlist as a JSON array of {Username,Secret,ExternalSubject,DisplayName} objects, bound to Authentication:StaffIdentity:Accounts (story login/06). Empty by default -> no staff can sign in (fail closed). Expanded below into the indexed env-var keys the .NET options binder reads. Threaded like jwtSecretKey; never committed.

Generation:Provider discriminator. Fake = in-process, no egress (the fail-closed default CI/prod keep). AzureOpenAI/ClaudeFoundry = a live, EGRESSING endpoint — only ever set from main.bicep's generationProviderLive toggle, which is gated on the PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md §8 Tier-2 sign-off.
Generation:Endpoint — the tenant-bounded endpoint URI (= ai.bicep output "endpoint"). Empty when no governed endpoint is provisioned.
Generation:ApiVersion — the Azure OpenAI data-plane api-version. A client-side choice, NOT a provisioned resource property (PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md §4).
Generation:Tiers:Standard:Deployment (= an ai.bicep deployment name). NOTE: main.bicep currently aliases this to the AMBIENT deployment — a TEMPORARY shim, see its generationStandardTier* locals.
Generation:Tiers:Standard:Model (= an ai.bicep model name). NOTE: TEMPORARILY aliased to the Ambient model by main.bicep — see its generationStandardTier* locals.
Generation:Tiers:Ambient:Deployment (= ai.bicep output "ambientDeploymentName").
Generation:Tiers:Ambient:Model (= ai.bicep output "ambientModelName").
Generation:Governance:Residency — documented data residency (= ai.bicep output "residency", the deployment region). NFR-005.

Generation:Governance:TenantBounded — attests the endpoint is bounded to this tenant (single-tenant Cognitive Services account, disableLocalAuth, no shared/public inference). False by default: an unattested posture makes AddEngineGeneration throw at startup for a real provider (fail closed).

Generation:Governance:NoTrainingAttested — attests customer prompts/completions are not used to train the model (Microsoft product terms for Azure OpenAI; the Anthropic Marketplace offer for Claude). False by default (fail closed).

Generation:Governance:Retention — the attestable retention posture. Retained is today's posture (standard retention under the no-training contract); switch to ZeroDataRetention only once the per-subscription abuse-monitoring/ZDR approval lands (PROVIDER-GOVERNANCE.md §2). Never left Unspecified.

metadata.description: Custom domain to bind (e.g. pulse-uat.cobrasoftware.com). Empty = none. A subdomain validated via a CNAME to defaultHostname; Azure auto-issues the managed TLS cert. Leave empty to skip.
Azure region for the AI Foundry account.
AI Foundry (Cognitive Services AIServices) account name, e.g. aif-pulse-uat.
Custom subdomain — REQUIRED for Entra ID token auth. Defaults to the account name.
Public network access. Enabled for the sandbox; tighten to a private endpoint when the backend vnet lands.
Model-deployment SKU. DataZoneStandard keeps data within the US data zone (residency, NFR-005); GlobalStandard has the widest availability but may route globally.
Standard tier — storyline-critical reactions (top voice quality).
Standard-tier capacity (thousands of tokens/min).
Ambient tier — bulk background chatter (cheaper/faster, the volume driver).
Ambient-tier capacity (thousands of tokens/min).

Also deploy the Claude-on-Foundry model tiers (serverless MaaS) alongside the Azure OpenAI ones. Requires a Claude-eligible subscription; the Marketplace offer is auto-accepted via modelProviderData below.
Claude Standard tier — storyline-critical reactions (top voice quality). Sonnet-tier. Confirm the id against the live catalog (Get-ClaudeCatalog.ps1).
Claude Standard-tier SKU. DataZoneStandard keeps data in the US data zone (residency, NFR-005) and is supported by claude-sonnet-5 / claude-opus-4-8.
Claude Standard-tier capacity (thousands of tokens/min).
Claude Ambient tier — bulk background chatter. Haiku-tier.
Claude Ambient-tier SKU. GlobalStandard is the widely available default; switch to DataZoneStandard if the ambient model supports it in the target region.
Claude Ambient-tier capacity (thousands of tokens/min).
Model version for the Claude deployments. Foundry uses a generic "1" for Anthropic families (versionUpgradeOption tracks the default).
Legal organization name recorded on the Anthropic Marketplace acceptance (modelProviderData).
Two-letter ISO country code for the Marketplace acceptance (modelProviderData).
Industry for the Marketplace acceptance (modelProviderData), e.g. government, technology. Lowercased automatically (Foundry requires lowercase).

Object (principal) id of the backend managed identity to grant the data-plane role(s): "Cognitive Services OpenAI User" (OpenAI surface) and, when deployClaude is set, "Cognitive Services User" (Claude/Anthropic surface). Empty = skip the role assignment (grant your az-login identity manually for the local measured spike).
